about: Edition-specific services and alternatives. Experience League is the starting source for every service.

lines.name: Journey Optimizer access and sandbox setup
lines.scope: Configure Journey Optimizer roles and sandboxes. Map the licensed channels to the first use cases and record the channel settings the implementation needs.
lines.evidence: Define all the technical parameters required for email, mobile messages, push notifications, web push, direct mail, and other channels

lines.name: Journey Optimizer email channel configuration
lines.scope: For a licensed email channel, delegate the sending subdomain and configure the IP pool, email headers, execution fields and consent settings. Test the email channel using an approved profile.
lines.evidence: Configure the technical parameters (subdomain, IP pool, headers) in each email channel configuration

source.title: Experience League: Journey Optimizer email configuration

lines.name: First scheduled campaigns in Journey Optimizer
lines.scope: Build and test the agreed scheduled campaigns using existing Experience Platform audiences and the licensed channels. Configure campaign settings and schedule and validate the first test send or delivery.
lines.evidence: Audiences must be available in Adobe Experience Platform before creating campaigns.

source.title: Experience League: Get started with Journey Optimizer campaigns

lines.name: Audience entry and profile events in Journey Optimizer Starter
lines.scope: Configure the agreed audience entry or supported profile-level entry for the first journeys. Test data and actions with sample profiles. Business-event setup is excluded for this package.
lines.evidence: Start with a Read Audience: you can set your journey to listen to Adobe Experience Platform audiences.

source.title: Experience League: Journey Optimizer audiences in journeys

lines.name: AEM Assets users and access setup
lines.scope: Set up user groups and attach product profiles for the agreed AEM Assets environment. Validate author, administrator and restricted user access.
lines.evidence: Adds users to the Adobe Admin Console organization, creates user groups, and attaches product profiles to groups.

source.title: Experience League: AEM user groups and product profiles

lines.name: Standard AEM Assets renditions
lines.scope: Configure standard processing profiles for the agreed asset folders and check that sample uploads generate the expected renditions.
lines.evidence: Several asset processing profiles can be configured on the folder, into which assets are uploaded, to add specific metadata, renditions

source.title: Experience League: AEM Assets processing profiles

lines.name: AEM 6.5 maintenance and service packs
lines.scope: Review the service packs that apply to the deployment. Validate applicable updates in a test environment, run the agreed checks, coordinate production installation and review logs and rollback readiness.
lines.evidence: Restart the instance before installation if the instance is in update mode

source.title: Experience League: AEM 6.5 service pack installation

lines.name: Upgrade AEM 6.5 to AEM 6.5 LTS
lines.scope: Assess the existing AEM 6.5 environment, extensions and runtime requirements. Rehearse the upgrade on a copy, update the agreed code and configuration, run acceptance tests and plan the production cutover and rollback.
lines.evidence: The upgrade to AEM 6.5 LTS is available for all supported 6.5 Service Packs.

source.title: Experience League: Upgrade to AEM 6.5 LTS

lines.name: AEM 6.5 go-live validation
lines.scope: Verify the agreed author and publish environments, test the critical publishing and page paths, confirm backups and rollback and agree the cutover sequence.

source.title: Experience League: AEM 6.5 LTS post-upgrade checks

lines.name: Target users and audience setup
lines.scope: Set up Adobe Target users and roles in Admin Console. Configure the agreed environments, reporting settings and initial audiences.
lines.evidence: Add users and manage their permissions in the Adobe Admin Console for a Target Standard account.

source.title: Experience League: Target Standard user permissions

lines.name: Marketo Engage lead scoring and data hygiene
lines.scope: Audit lead data, standardize agreed fields, set up lead scoring and test the handoff to sales with representative leads.

source.title: Experience League: Plan a new Marketo Engage implementation

lines.name: Marketo Engage sandbox validation
lines.scope: Configure an entitled sandbox for the agreed implementation tests. Scope test data and CRM connections, validate the programs and document the promotion steps.
lines.evidence: A Marketo Engage sandbox is an additional instance used for testing purposes before implementation in the production environment.

lines.name: Workfront environment promotion setup
lines.scope: Map the sandbox and target environment, package the agreed Workfront objects with their dependencies, and validate an installation rehearsal before moving changes to production.

source.title: Experience League: Workfront environment promotion packages

lines.name: Workfront custom field localization
lines.scope: Inventory the agreed custom field labels and tooltips, configure translated terms and verify the displayed language with users.
lines.evidence: Localization applies to custom field labels (including when used as a column header) and tooltips.

lines.name: Workfront Data Connect reporting setup
lines.scope: Set up the Workfront Data Connect reader account and a connection for the approved reporting tool. Configure the network allowlist and verify sample reporting queries.
lines.evidence: Then, you must add any required IPs to the allowlist

source.title: Experience League: Connect to Workfront Data Connect

lines.name: Workfront Ultimate financial setup
lines.scope: Configure approved job role and user cost rates, validate planned and actual cost calculations against sample Workfront projects, and agree who maintains the rates.
lines.evidence: To track costs, you must associate users and job roles with hourly cost rates.

source.title: Experience League: Track costs in Workfront

quotes: Prime package may be licensed without email and direct mail channels upon request.
Ultimate Starter package does not include an event configuration to support business events.
Customer may deploy 1 Production Environment. AEM Assets Prime cannot be customized.
AEM as a Cloud Service, AEM 6.5 LTS, and AEM 6.5 are the only supported AEM backends.
Properties and Permissions functionality is available as part of the Target Premium solution.
They are not available in Target Standard without a Target Premium license.
Digital Rights Management (DRM) is supported for Enterprise Prime accounts only.
Marketo Measure Entitlement level is dependent on scale of license purchased by Customer
